harness_equivalence.rule: the SAME frozen harness and config used for the S0D and S1A rollouts

binding_gates.morphology_causal_contract_failure: rows_positive 0 AND max 0 AND failure false, read PER ROW from reward_terms.morphology_causal_failed_closed, never inferred from end_reason
binding_gates.penetration: max <= 0.020 m and no grf_penetration termination
binding_gates.recording: ALL v3 FSM counters, end_reason and cycles recorded verbatim, with no reinterpretation

mandatory_comparison_not_a_gate.rule: the A2-vs-S0D-vs-AB06-IK comparison on the RESULTING closed trace is diagnostic ONLY and may never change or relax a gate
mandatory_comparison_not_a_gate.offline_vs_closed_loop: offline metrics were computed on the FROZEN S0D-visited rows (fit stage); the closed-loop metrics here are computed on A2's OWN newly visited states. The two are NOT comparable term by term and are reported in separate blocks
content: sign, range, min, max and mean of the prosthetic knee and ankle
RMSE, Pearson correlation, sign agreement and amplitude ratio vs the prescribed targets
A2 recorded actions vs what S0D would output on the SAME visited states
A2 recorded actions vs AB06 u_IK at the same times on the visited trace
morphological quality useful to judge whether the biological direction improved
B3 only inside the phase window [0.55, 0.80], not_evaluable if the phase field is zero

outcome_policy.on_pass: mark ONLY CLOSED_LOOP_ELIGIBLE_PENDING_ARCHITECT_AUDIT; no promotion, no deployable status, no anchor construction, STOP
outcome_policy.on_fail: quarantine the candidate, write a causal collaborative diagnosis, NO relaunch, NO tuning, STOP
outcome_policy.either_way: no write under student/, candidate flags unchanged, sigma NOT declared resolved
